name: bloxdblocks
description: BloxdBlocks visual editor for Bloxd.io world code
author: BloxdBlocks Contributors

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:favicon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis-web --x64 && node scripts/publish-release.cjs win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:favicon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --universal && node scripts/publish-release.cjs mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:favicon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux deb --x64 && node scripts/publish-release.cjs linux
